title: Associates Programme
institution: The Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP)
about: ICTP's Associates Programme supports scientists working in developing countries through research visits to ICTP. Regular Associates are aged 36 to 45, Senior Associates 46 to 65; both need a PhD. Applications close 31 January 2027, for visits starting in 2028.
requirements: Regular Associates: scientists aged 36 to 45 working in developing countries
Senior Associates: scientists aged 46 to 65 working in a developing country
PhD and main affiliation in a developing country required
Apply through ICTP's online application system by 31 January 2027; successful applicants can visit ICTP from 2028
card_alt: Card for the Associates Programme at The Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP), Trieste, Italy, application deadline 31 January 2027.
